confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate from general knowledge of Vang Vieng's backpacker market, not from live menus, booking pages, or current listings. Restaurant and bar prices are the more reliable anchors. Hostel and hotel prices are less certain, and the 3-star figure is the weakest. July is green-season low demand, so accommodation anchors may sit at or below typical rates. Lao kip volatility also affects local prices in USD. Cocktail and wine were set from the local beer relationship because direct knowledge is weak: cocktail at about 3x beer and wine glass at about 5x beer.
comparable_city_reasoning: Regional basis: Lao backpacker and small-town tourist pricing, benchmarked against other Southeast Asian riverside and backpacker towns in Laos and northern Thailand. Luang Prabang is treated as a pricier upper bound and was not used directly.
